title: Phylacteries
summary: Phylacteries were small Scripture-containing boxes associated with the command to bind God’s words as a sign.
background: By Jesus’ day, visible religious practices could become opportunities for pride when outward display replaced humble obedience.
teachingHelp: When teaching Matthew 23, explain the practice briefly but emphasize Jesus’ concern: religious display without inward humility.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
